# text

Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.

---

## `text_copy_2fa_code`

Pick a 2FA account with fzf and copy its current code to the clipboard.

**Usage**

```sh
text_copy_2fa_code
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_copy_2fa_code
```

**Requires** `2fa`, `fzf`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:280`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L280)

## `text_copy_and_announce`

Copy text to the clipboard and announce it with a talking cow. Degrades to cowsay, then to a plain echo.

**Usage**

```sh
text_copy_and_announce <text>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_copy_and_announce "deploy finished"
```

**Requires** (`xcowsay` or `cowsay`)

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:245`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L245)

---

## `text_decode_base64`

Base64-decode arguments, or stdin when called with none.

**Usage**

```sh
text_decode_base64 [encoded]...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_decode_base64 aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=
clip_paste | text_decode_base64
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:32`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L32)

**See also** `text_encode_base64`

---

## `text_encode_base64`

Base64-encode arguments, or stdin when called with none. Always one line, no wrapping, on both BSD and GNU base64.

**Usage**

```sh
text_encode_base64 [text]...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_encode_base64 'hello world'
cat id_rsa.pub | text_encode_base64
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:17`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L17)

**See also** `text_decode_base64`

## `text_grep_env`

Grep the environment case-insensitively. With no argument it prints the whole environment.

**Usage**

```sh
text_grep_env [pattern]
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_grep_env proxy
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:133`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L133)

## `text_load_env_file`

Export every variable defined in a dotenv file. Handles values that contain spaces, '=', '#' or quotes — the old `export $(sed ... | xargs)` mangled all of those.

**Usage**

```sh
text_load_env_file [file]
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_load_env_file
text_load_env_file .env.production
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:149`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L149)

**See also** `text_unload_env_file`

---

## `text_make_qrcode`

Render text as a QR code directly in the terminal.

**Usage**

```sh
text_make_qrcode <text>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_make_qrcode 'WIFI:S:guest;T:WPA;P:hunter2;;'
```

**Requires** `qrencode`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:263`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L263)

## `text_pretty_json`

Pretty print JSON from a file or stdin. Uses jq when available and falls back to python3's json.tool.

**Usage**

```sh
text_pretty_json [file]
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_pretty_json package.json
curl -s https://api.github.com | text_pretty_json
```

**Requires** (`jq` or `python3`)

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:115`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L115)

---

## `text_random_password`

Generate a random password of the given length. Prints it by default; with --copy it goes to the clipboard and is never echoed.

**Usage**

```sh
text_random_password [length] [--copy]
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_random_password
text_random_password 32 --copy
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:213`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L213)

## `text_show_binary`

Print the 8-bit binary representation of every character in the given text, one character per line.

**Usage**

```sh
text_show_binary <text>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_show_binary hi
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:70`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L70)

**See also** `text_show_binary_inline`

## `text_show_binary_inline`

Print the binary for some text as a single space-separated line, followed by the original text.

**Usage**

```sh
text_show_binary_inline <text>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_show_binary_inline hi
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:87`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L87)

## `text_split_lines`

Split comma-separated values onto one line each.

**Usage**

```sh
text_split_lines <csv>
```

**Examples**

```sh
text_split_lines aaa,bbb,ccc
text_split_lines a,b,c | xargs -I{} echo "item {}"
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/text.sh:57`](../../modules/common/text.sh#L57)

## `text_split_to_json_array`

Turn space-separated words into a JSON array of strings, ready to paste into a config file.

**Usage**

```sh

```

**Examples**

```sh

```
